title: Shortest tour through 400 cities
inspiredBy: ALE-Bench (heuristic optimization with a continuous score)
goal: Follow TASK.md: find the shortest closed tour you can through the cities in cities.txt and write it to tour.txt. The score is continuous: shorter is better, with no ceiling until well below a plain 2-opt tour. Try different heuristics in parallel (construction, 2-opt, Or-opt, simulated annealing, Lin-Kernighan style moves) and keep the best. Each worker leaves its best tour.txt in its own workspace; the best one counts.
rubric: Only valid tours count (every city exactly once). Report measured tour lengths. Diverse methods beat everyone polishing the same one; share what works on the board.
